enhanced_resume.name: Rajesh Govindarajan
enhanced_resume.summary: Strategic IT Leader and Principal Engineer with 20+ years architecting distributed, enterprise-scale systems and 2+ years delivering production-grade agentic AI and AI/ML solutions on cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP). Deep expertise in systems engineering, system architecture, and system integration, with hands-on delivery of data pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and multi-agent orchestration for customer-facing conversational AI products. Proven record of translating business requirements into technical specifications, governing build-vs-buy decisions, and managing complex technical programs using Agile methodologies (PMP certified, MBA). Adept at bridging technical complexity with product strategy and business outcomes while scaling high-performing AI engineering teams across cross-functional organizations.
skills: Memory Architectures (short-term context, long-term customer memory)

experience.title: Engineered an LLM-powered solution for Marketing automation (MarTech
bullets: Designed and delivered an LLM-powered marketing automation (MarTech) platform, translating stakeholder requirements into technical specifications and system architecture for production deployment.
Built scalable data pipelines and AI/ML model deployment workflows on cloud-based services (AWS/Azure/GCP), enabling reliable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and stateful agent execution.
Integrated agentic AI capabilities into existing enterprise systems, ensuring seamless system integration, governed data flow, and API-first interoperability with downstream MarTech tooling.
Drove iterative delivery using Agile methodologies, managing timelines, resources, and deployment risk while maintaining clear documentation of designs and operational procedures.
Partnered with data scientists, AI researchers, and business stakeholders to align AI roadmap and build-vs-buy decisions with measurable business outcomes.

experience.title: ●​ Headed the creation and growth of three AI communities in the Austin area
bullets: Founded and scaled three Austin-area AI communities, growing cross-functional engineering and data science membership through structured programming and technical events.
Led technical workshops on agentic architectures, AI/ML model deployment, and cloud-based AI services, elevating practitioner capability across the local ecosystem.
Cultivated partnerships with enterprises and practitioners to share best practices in system architecture, automation, and responsible enterprise AI adoption.

experience.title: and AI Collective. Currently establishing the foundational framework for community
bullets: Established the foundational technical and governance framework for the Agentics Foundation community, defining architecture standards and documentation practices for agentic systems.
Authored reference architectures and requirements guidance covering multi-agent orchestration, agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols, and memory architectures for production deployments.
Coordinated contributors and working groups, applying project and risk management principles to deliver community initiatives on schedule.

experience.title: Agentic Engineer
bullets: Architected and shipped production-grade agentic AI systems using LangGraph, CrewAI, and Semantic Kernel, including interruptible voice and conversational AI agents.
Implemented multi-agent orchestration, short-term context and long-term customer memory, and RAG retrieval layers deployed on cloud infrastructure for scalability and resilience.
Applied prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and post-training strategies with PyTorch/TensorFlow to improve agent accuracy, latency, and customer engagement.
Automated model and pipeline deployment through CI/CD-style workflows, reducing release friction and improving operational reliability of deployed AI/ML solutions.
